### Offline / test mode

Edit `lib/shared/configs/vars.dart` and change `useMockRepository` to `true`
in the `Vars` class to skip real network calls. In code the flag is read as
`CustomConfigs.vars.useMockRepository`.
Mock data lives in `lib/shared/jsons/user_json.dart`; access it via `CustomJsons.userJson` (the barrel facade).

### Android emulator host

Change `host` in `lib/shared/configs/uries.dart` from `localhost` → `10.0.2.2`.
Revert before committing.

### Generated files

`*.g.dart` and `*.freezed.dart` files are generated — do not edit by hand.

- `*.g.dart` files are generated by `build_runner` for: `@riverpod`-annotated files (`riverpod_generator`), `@JsonSerializable` files (`json_serializable`), and Drift `@DriftDatabase` files (`drift_dev`).
- `*.freezed.dart` files are generated by `build_runner` for `@freezed`-annotated files (`freezed`).

Every file that contains a `@riverpod` annotation also declares `part '<filename>.g.dart';` at the top. Re-generate all generated files with:

```bash
# Run from project root
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
```
